attack: approve an invoice that was never matched

body.detail: Invoice inv-93068080 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

expected: 400 with rule three_way_match_gate. docs/API.md Business rules row 4: an invoice cannot be approved until it passed the 3-way match.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule three_way_match_gate. Invoice inv-93068080 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

attack: receive 20 units of a line ordered for 4

body.detail: Cannot receive 20 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 4, already received 0.

expected: 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit. docs/API.md Business rules row 2: received quantity never exceeds ordered quantity.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule receive_quantity_limit. Cannot receive 20 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 4, already received 0.

attack: invoice the received quantity at double the price

body.detail: Invoice total 95.00 plus already invoiced 0.00 exceeds received value 47.50.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection. docs/API.md Business rules row 3: invoiced total value never exceeds what was received. There is no tolerance.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule overpayment_protection. Invoice total 95.00 plus already invoiced 0.00 exceeds received value 47.50.

attack: create a purchase order for a vendor created with active false

body.detail: Vendor vnd-4f257ad6 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

expected: 400 with rule inactive_vendor_gate. docs/API.md Business rules row 1: no purchase order can be created for an inactive vendor.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule inactive_vendor_gate. Vendor vnd-4f257ad6 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

attack: second delivery puts the first line one unit over its ordered quantity

body.detail: Cannot receive 1 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 10, already received 10.

expected: 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit. docs/API.md Business rules row 2: the limit holds across all deliveries. The PO is still submitted, so workflow_gate is the wrong rule.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule receive_quantity_limit. Cannot receive 1 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 10, already received 10.

attack: invoice one cent over the received value
expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection. docs/API.md Business rules row 3: no tolerance, including one cent.
reason: Accepted with status 201. Expected a 400 refusal under overpayment_protection.

attack: invoice half a percent over the received value
expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection. docs/API.md Business rules row 3: no tolerance. 1005.00 is 0.5 percent over the 1000.00 received.
reason: Accepted with status 201. Expected a 400 refusal under overpayment_protection.

attack: invoice one unit over the receipt at a price that keeps the extended value under the receipt

body.detail: Cannot invoice 11 of LUM-2X4-8: received 10, already invoiced 0.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection. docs/API.md Business rules row 3: per-line quantity cannot exceed what was received, even when the extended value is lower.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule overpayment_protection. Cannot invoice 11 of LUM-2X4-8: received 10, already invoiced 0.

attack: invoice a submitted purchase order before any goods are received

body.detail: Cannot invoice 1 of LUM-2X4-8: received 0, already invoiced 0.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection. docs/API.md Business rules row 3 and row 10: a submitted PO may be invoiced, but the invoice cannot exceed the received value of 0.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule overpayment_protection. Cannot invoice 1 of LUM-2X4-8: received 0, already invoiced 0.

attack: second invoice makes the two invoices together exceed the receipt

body.detail: Cannot invoice 6 of LUM-2X4-8: received 10, already invoiced 6.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection. docs/API.md Business rules row 3: everything invoiced on a PO, across invoices, never exceeds what was received.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule overpayment_protection. Cannot invoice 6 of LUM-2X4-8: received 10, already invoiced 6.

attack: invoice prices 0.1 and 0.2 that equal the received value
expected: 201 with total_amount 0.30. docs/API.md Business rules row 3 forbids only an excess, and Basics rounds money to cents. 0.10 + 0.20 equals the receipt.
reason: Invoice accepted with total_amount 0.3, equal to the received value 0.30.

attack: purchase order line with quantity 0

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: docs/API.md Purchase orders: quantity must be greater than 0. No named business rule covers zero. A 4xx rejection is undocumented; a 2xx is a breach.
reason: Rejected quantity 0 with status 400 and rule validation_error. The Purchase orders section states the numeric limits, and none of the 11 named business rules covers this input. line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

attack: purchase order line with a negative quantity

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: docs/API.md Purchase orders: quantity must be greater than 0. No named business rule covers a negative quantity. A 4xx rejection is undocumented; a 2xx is a breach.
reason: Rejected quantity -5 with status 400 and rule validation_error. The Purchase orders section states the numeric limits, and none of the 11 named business rules covers this input. line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

attack: purchase order line with a negative unit price

body.detail: line_items.0.unit_price: unit_price must be 0 or more

expected: docs/API.md Purchase orders: unit_price is from 0 to 100,000. No named business rule covers a negative price. A 4xx rejection is undocumented; a 2xx is a breach.
reason: Rejected unit_price -1 with status 400 and rule validation_error. The Purchase orders section states the numeric limits, and none of the 11 named business rules covers this input. line_items.0.unit_price: unit_price must be 0 or more

attack: purchase order line with unit price 0
expected: 201. docs/API.md Purchase orders allows unit_price from 0 to 100,000, so zero is a valid price.
reason: Draft purchase order was created with unit_price 0, which is inside the documented range of 0 to 100,000.

attack: second invoice number differs only by letter case
expected: 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection. docs/API.md Business rules row 6: invoice numbers are compared ignoring upper or lower case. The second invoice quantity still fits the receipt.
reason: Accepted with status 201. Expected a 400 refusal under duplicate_invoice_detection.

attack: second invoice number differs only by surrounding spaces
expected: 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection. docs/API.md Business rules row 6: surrounding spaces are ignored. The second invoice quantity still fits the receipt.
reason: Accepted with status 201. Expected a 400 refusal under duplicate_invoice_detection.

attack: same invoice number on a second vendor
expected: 201. docs/API.md Business rules row 6 and OpenAPI POST /invoices: invoice numbers are unique per vendor, so another vendor may reuse the number.
reason: The second vendor created an invoice with the same invoice number. Uniqueness is per vendor.

attack: match when the last purchase-order line is only partly received
expected: 200 and partial_receipt true. docs/API.md Business rules row 5: the flag is true when any line of the PO is not fully received.
reason: partial_receipt is false, expected true.

attack: match when the first purchase-order line is only partly received
expected: 200 and partial_receipt true. docs/API.md Business rules row 5. The short line is first so a check of only the last line would miss it.
reason: Match returned partial_receipt true.

attack: match when every purchase-order line is fully received
expected: 200 and partial_receipt false. docs/API.md Business rules row 5 sets the flag only when some line is not fully received. The match example shows false for a full receipt.
reason: Match returned partial_receipt false.

attack: receive goods against a draft purchase order

body.detail: Goods can only be received on a submitted purchase order. po-ad2528a2 is draft.

expected: 400 with rule workflow_gate. docs/API.md Business rules row 10: receive only on a submitted purchase order.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule workflow_gate. Goods can only be received on a submitted purchase order. po-ad2528a2 is draft.

attack: submit a purchase order that is already submitted

body.detail: Only draft purchase orders can be submitted. po-6d19004b is submitted.

expected: 400 with rule workflow_gate. docs/API.md Business rules row 10: submit only a draft.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule workflow_gate. Only draft purchase orders can be submitted. po-6d19004b is submitted.

attack: invoice a draft purchase order

body.detail: Purchase order po-bd9b0003 is still a draft. Submit it before invoicing.

expected: 400 with rule workflow_gate. docs/API.md Business rules row 10: invoice only a submitted or closed purchase order.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule workflow_gate. Purchase order po-bd9b0003 is still a draft. Submit it before invoicing.

attack: match an invoice that is already approved

body.detail: Invoice inv-85ccaa53 is already approved and cannot be matched again.

expected: 400 with rule workflow_gate. docs/API.md Business rules row 10: never match an approved invoice again.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule workflow_gate. Invoice inv-85ccaa53 is already approved and cannot be matched again.

attack: approve an invoice a second time
expected: 400 with rule duplicate_approval. docs/API.md Business rules row 9: an invoice can be approved only once.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule duplicate_approval. Invoice inv-f36c11ed is already approved.

attack: invoice a catalog SKU that is not on the purchase order

body.detail: SKU PLY-12-4X8 is not on the purchase order.

expected: 400 with rule invoice_line_validation. docs/API.md Business rules row 8: every invoice line is for a SKU on the PO.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule invoice_line_validation. SKU PLY-12-4X8 is not on the purchase order.

attack: invoice the same SKU on two lines

body.detail: SKU LUM-2X4-8 appears more than once on the invoice.

expected: 400 with rule invoice_line_validation. docs/API.md Business rules row 8: each SKU appears once on the invoice.
reason: Refused with 400 and rule invoice_line_validation. SKU LUM-2X4-8 appears more than once on the invoice.

attack: approve a matched invoice and check the ledger totals
expected: 200, gl_entry.balanced true, and total debits equal total credits equal 11.75. docs/API.md Business rules row 7 and Basics (money rounded to cents).
reason: Debits and credits both equal 11.75 and balanced is true.

attack: approve an invoice priced at 0.1 and 0.2 and check the ledger totals
expected: 200, balanced true, and debits and credits both 0.30. docs/API.md Business rules row 7. 0.10 + 0.20 must not drift.
reason: Debits and credits both equal 0.30 and balanced is true.

attack: exposure after one approved invoice
expected: 200 and open_ap_liability equal to that invoice total_amount, with that invoice id in approved_invoices. docs/API.md Business rules row 11.
reason: open_ap_liability 19.2 equals the approved invoice total 19.20, and approved_invoices lists only those invoices.

attack: exposure sums two approved invoices and ignores an unapproved one
expected: 200 and open_ap_liability 42.50, listing only the two approved invoice ids. docs/API.md Business rules row 11: exposure is the sum of total_amount over approved invoices.
reason: open_ap_liability 42.5 equals the approved invoice total 42.50, and approved_invoices lists only those invoices.

attack: exposure of approved invoices priced at 0.1 and 0.2
expected: 200 and open_ap_liability 0.30 for the two approved invoices. docs/API.md Business rules row 11 and Basics: dollars rounded to cents. 0.10 + 0.20 is 0.30.
reason: open_ap_liability 0.3 equals the approved invoice total 0.30, and approved_invoices lists only those invoices.
